items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: And Jimmy Talbert is your nephew?

ctx.x: And Boots' name was Austin Young and Sport's name was Isaiah Isai Young, is that right?
I have no idea. No, Jimmy would know. You know, Jimmy would know, but I wouldn't. I have no idea what it was.
And Jimmy Talbert is your nephew?
